svg.title: How I learned the GB10's machine code
svg.desc: Three sources and one rule: NVIDIA's compiler output on my own probe kernels, Mesa's open NAK compiler, and the chip itself. Nothing is believed until the GPU runs it and gives the right answer.

Inter, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: NVIDIA publishes no instruction encoding for its GPUs. I worked it out, and checked every answer on the chip.
